images.name: G05_level3_under_the_table
images.final_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create polished cinematic 3D promotional key art of this specific Roblox co-op horror game, faithful to the supplied screenshots' geometry, colors and materials. Reference images are identity/environment references, not edit targets. Rebuild the real party room with improved practical lighting, depth, slight haze and fine grain. Strong simple composition readable at thumbnail size. Do not copy reference HUD or UI.
Every player is an identical stylized chunky game avatar about three heads tall, mustard yellow crumpled hooded hazmat suit, hood up, black gas mask with TWO ROUND lenses and ONE round front filter, black backpack straps, belt with pouches, black tactical backpack with two small olive side tanks, black mitten gloves and chunky black boots. No realistic humans, bare faces or clear visors.
The one Mall Manager is extremely tall and thin, with a glossy RED BALLOON head with NO face, wide orange and cream VERTICAL striped short-sleeved shirt and blank white name tag, black trousers, white belt buckle, black shoes, very long thin pale arms and RED gloves. Natural requested pose, never the reference rig pose.
No lettering whatsoever: no title, captions, logo, watermark, HUD, UI, key hints, numbers, name-tag writing, disc writing or readable carpet characters. No blood, gore, weapons, extra creatures, new props or jump-scare faces. All non-close-up characters wholly inside frame. Follow the specified negative space, leave it empty for later typography.
Format: widest landscape 3:2; keep all important subjects within the middle 80% of image height for later center crop to 16:9.
Listed references in order: refs/l3_04_party_room_road_carpet_cd_on_folding_table_player.jpg; refs/l3_02_mall_manager_look_reference_bind_pose_red_balloon_head.jpg; refs/l3_03_mall_manager_upper_body_striped_shirt_name_tag.jpg; refs/krille/krille_12.png; refs/player_suit_front.jpg
Scene: Camera at floor level in the road-map-carpet party room of the reference. In the right foreground two players lie flat on their fronts UNDER a cream folding table, heads together, perfectly still. Past the table legs, four metres away, the Mall Manager walks slowly through the room: seen whole, stooping a little, its red balloon head turning toward the table, red-gloved hands hanging at the ends of its long arms. Dim ceiling panels, paper cups on the table above them.
Leave the LOWER-LEFT corner (about a third of the width, a fifth of the height) calm and darker for a small "LEVEL" line. No lettering.
Composition correction: pull the camera back far enough to show BOTH entire prone avatars, including every boot and backpack, wholly inside the right half with clear margins. They are small chunky three-heads-tall game characters, NOT human-sized proportions. No player body may be clipped at the right edge. Show them lengthwise under the table, heads together turned toward camera.
images.remaining_issue: The avatars' prone bodies are slightly longer than the chunky reference proportions, and the exact four-metre distance is only visually implied.
